extraction.Name: Blanche Bill (Matlock)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to C. E. Vandervoort, Sr. for $5000.00; Land deeded to C. E. Vandervoort, Sr. for $5000
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered Nov. 26, 1917, by mail; patent receipted for: yes; date of redemption expired: no; two minor children dependent upon her for support; it is the opinion of the Agency that the allottee should have received more money for her land; no evidence of fraud appears to have been practiced; document notarized November 28, 1928, County of Pawnee, State of Oklahoma; notary commission expires Jan. 31, 1929; no property or funds accumulated
